items.gate_reason: The quote's use of 'layer' language defaults the assignment to structural-position per the boundary rules, not composition.
Although the relation string is 'is-analogue-of', the quote asserts identity ('is in the last analysis Luna'), which decides the family.
The relation 'is-analogue-of' and the quote's 'corresponds to' assert structural likeness without identity, which is correspondence.
The quote defines the subject as a 'longing to attain rebirth', which is a clear statement of goal-direction and attainment belonging to telos, not manifestation.
The boundary rule states that generation begets beings while derivation transmits ideas and forms; the lapis as a 'child' is a begotten entity.
The boundary rule explicitly states that nucleus, centre, and foundation language defaults to structural-position.
The quote explicitly frames the relation as an 'analogy', which asserts structural likeness across traditions and belongs in correspondence.
The relation string is 'personifies' and the quote explicitly states the figure 'personifies' the content, which routes to personification, not manifestation.
The subject showing itself under a guise (whore/meretrix) is manifestation, whereas privation requires a stated lack or absence.
The subject is a named carrier (Basil the Great) performing an act of predication ('holds evil to be'), which routes to doctrinal-attribution.
The boundary rules explicitly place 'amounts-to' and flat equivalence of the terms in archetypal-identity.
The edge 'the-devil is-fourth-person-beside the-trinity' is an explicit seed for structural-position, denoting an ordinal place within a structure.
Historical or doctrinal descent ('had a pagan Gnostic precursor') is explicitly derivation.
A dynamic act with an outcome ('prevents the unconscious from breaking out') is a psychic-effect, not correspondence.
The quote asserts they are synonyms for the same referent, which the document explicitly places in archetypal-identity.
The act of joining distinct terms ('unites the opposites') is union, not correspondence.
The quote frames the relation as an act of interpretation by a named carrier ('Maier obviously has in mind'), which outranks the surface verb and routes to doctrinal-attribution.
The text asserts identity between the terms and no specific carrier is named to route it to doctrinal-attribution, so it belongs in archetypal-identity.
The quote identifies Luna as a participant in the hierosgamos, establishing a part-whole relationship that belongs in composition.

false_positives.reason: The quote asserts naming/synonymy ('might be called'), which classifies as archetypal-identity regardless of the 'corresponds-to' relation string.

The quote describes rebirth as a 'psychic reality' (a property or domain attribution to the psyche), which does not fit composition's part-whole constituency and belongs in the recorded property-attribution gap.

threshold: PASS = every planted item caught with the correct family named (should_be == was) and every class at quota; one miss or misdiagnosis in any class = FAIL. Set 2026-08-12 before the run (RULES #11). Specificity is reported, never gating.
